title: Senior Clinical Informatics Program Manager
description: Northwell Health is seeking an experienced Senior Clinical Informatics Program Manager to join our healthcare IT team. This role will be instrumental in the implementation and optimization of our eClinicalWorks EHR system. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in eClinicalWorks Core and a passion for improving clinical workflows through technology.
responsibilities: Collaborate with clinical stakeholders to gather requirements and design optimal workflows
Configure and customize eClinicalWorks applications to meet organizational needs
Develop and maintain project documentation, including design specifications and test plans
Participate in system testing, including unit testing, integration testing, and user acceptance testing
Provide go-live support and post-implementation optimization
Develop and manage project plans, timelines, and resource allocation
Report project status to executive leadership
Manage project budget and identify risk mitigation strategies
Facilitate steering committee meetings and stakeholder communications

required_qualifications.education: Bachelor's degree in Health Informatics, Healthcare Administration, IT, or related field
required_qualifications.experience: 10+ years of healthcare IT implementation experience
